# Catalog

* [Adult female dress-form measurements](adult-dress-form-measurements.md) - Measured bust, waist, hip and other dimensions of adult female dress forms and a display mannequin (Shop Co ASTM sizes 4-8, Mood, Best Mannequins, Greneker), in centimetres, with the caveat that brand sizing varies widely.
* [Child and teen mannequin and dress-form measurements](child-and-teen-form-measurements.md) - Measured chest, waist, hip, height and other dimensions of child and teen mannequins and dress forms (ages 8 to 18) from Econoco, Morplan, Eddie's, The Shop Company and a girls' standard chart, in centimetres.
* [Freely licensed 3D mannequin references](open-3d-mannequin-references.md) - CC0 and CC-BY 3D mannequin and dress-form models found online (itch.io, OpenGameArt, Sketchfab, Womp), their licences and usefulness as visual references; none downloaded.

# Domain Concept

* [Real-body proportions versus retail mannequins](real-body-vs-retail-mannequin.md) - Retail display mannequins are about 180 cm and dress size 4-6, taller and slimmer than real women and far from children's bodies; the app's mannequins deliberately use real-body (MakeHuman) proportions at ages 8, 13, 18 and 30, styled to look like mannequins, and should say so in the UI.
* [Retail display mannequins](retail-display-mannequins.md) - What a modern full-body display mannequin looks like: fibreglass, matte white, abstract egg head or headless, simplified hands and feet, numbered poses, round tempered-glass base with a calf rod, and adult proportions of about 180 cm and 86-61-91 cm.
* [Torso dress forms](torso-dress-forms.md) - How professional dressmaking, swim and display torso forms are built (fibreglass or papier-mache shell, felt, linen with style-line tape, collapsible shoulders, caster base with pedal height pole), where they are cut (hip, or mid-thigh for 3/4 swim forms), and suggested 3D presets.

# Section

* [Mannequins and dress forms](about.md) - Physical bodies used to show and fit leotards: retail display mannequins (finish, head, pose, stands, proportions), torso dress forms, child/teen/adult form measurements, freely licensed 3D references, and why our mannequins use real-body proportions.
